The brief planned this check on lesson 3's own product, (2 + j3)(1 − j2) = 8 − j = 3.606∠56.31° × 2.236∠−63.43° = 8.062∠−7.12°. The lesson uses (3 + j4)(4 + j3) = j25 instead, which is correct and cleaner, but it loses the link to a product Dan has already worked by hand. That link could go in the 'more' text.
The caption says "moduli" and "arguments", but every screen says lengths and angles; add "(lengths)" and "(angles)" after them, since lesson 5 named these words only once.
It says the tips snap to "whole steps of length and angle", but the drag snaps to half steps of length (0.5 to 3) and 10° steps of angle.
The statement that a star-delta transformer shifts the phase, and that two in a row shift it by the sum, is true trade knowledge but has no source and no 'from your trade' label; label it or cite it.
